meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show recorded output and cache-read token usage and mode attribution for the current Claude Code session, or locate the host's native usage report. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前会话的输出与缓存读取 token 用量及模式归属
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清这次会话到底消耗了多少 token。
copy.tagline_en: Check token and cache-read usage and mode attribution for the current session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how many tokens this session actually used

howto.what: 在 Claude Code 里触发 /caveman-stats 时,原样打印当前会话已记录的输出与 cache-read token 用量、响应次数和模式归属,不自行计算或重新四舍五入。其他宿主改用其原生用量报告。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 输入 /caveman-stats,或想查看当前会话 token 用量与模式归属时接管;在 Gemini CLI 中它改为指向 /stats model、/stats session 等原生命令。

say.text: 跑 /caveman-stats,把当前会话的用量报告原样贴出来
say.note: 会在代码块里原样展示报告

say.text: /caveman-stats --all 汇总各会话最新的输出计数
say.note: 按会话聚合最新记录的输出数

howto.what_en: In Claude Code, /caveman-stats prints the recorded output and cache-read token usage, response counts and mode attribution for the current session, verbatim. It does not recalculate or re-round the numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /caveman-stats in Claude Code. In Gemini CLI it points you to /stats model or /stats session; other hosts use a native usage report.

say_en.text: Run /caveman-stats and print this session's usage report verbatim
say_en.note: Prints the report in a code block

say_en.text: /caveman-stats --all to total the latest output count per session
